verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents connecting a GitHub repository or an agent opening pull requests against one. The closest items are a different capability (Droid posting review comments on existing PRs, factory-docs-38) and generic claims about delegating tasks, reviewing diffs, and merging. Neither establishes repo connection or PR creation, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it
